svg.title: SponsorFlow UX Sitemap
svg.desc: Public and designated login pages lead to five role-specific navigation groups. Rectangles are pages or grouped menus; smaller lines describe actions within pages. No database or workflow changes are made.
svg.text: Public entry pages, role-specific navigation, and key screens
Successful login grants only the assigned role’s navigation.
Approve or reject the whole batch
Decisions apply to the exact submitted
does not forward records to Accounting.
SHARED ACTION · Sign Out is available to every authenticated role.
Legend: Orange = shared entry pages/actions. Other colors identify the five role-specific navigation areas.
Solid lines show page hierarchy. Smaller text describes forms, dialogs, or actions within that page—not additional screens.
FASSG shortcuts from Programs or a finalized Fixed List open the same Create Batch dialog in the Application Queue.
